keys: help.labor_safety.text
en:
People → Workplace Safety: one card instead of SOUT, PPE, hazard milk and briefings. The rate is charged by the day (a game month is 14 days) and depends on the number of workers.
• [b]Minimum[/b] — free, but SOUT, milk, PPE and briefings are on you; the labor inspectorate fines every missed item.
• [b]By the law[/b] — 3,000 ₽ + 2,000 ₽ per worker a month: SOUT at all workplaces, hazard milk, PPE for everyone, the briefing log (30% fewer injuries). The inspection items are covered.
• [b]Exemplary[/b] — 9,000 ₽ + 4,000 ₽ per worker: plus SOUT again every 8 months, fresh PPE, a commission with the trade union; 40% fewer injuries and calmer people.
The PPE cabinet and the classroom can still be built: the classroom is for courses (People → Careers), and the briefing is held at its board.
